work.author: Brent Brenyo
work.description: A scholarly article on the 1917 British War Office venereal-disease film 'Whatsoever a Man Soweth', whose title is the appointed Epistle's Galatians 6:7 in the Authorized Version. Only the publisher's landing page was obtained; the article's own text is not held here, so nothing in the article may be cited from this library beyond what its abstract and citation metadata state.
work.title: 'Whatsoever a Man Soweth:' Sex Education about Venereal Disease, Racial Health, and Social Hygiene during the First World War
